AI Automation Services

AI assistants, AI agents, and n8n workflow automation

2S builds AI-driven systems that respond to inquiries, qualify leads, update your CRM, and trigger follow-up automatically — connected through n8n workflows so information moves between your tools without manual re-entry.

What can an AI assistant do for my business?

An AI assistant built by 2S can respond to new inquiries, ask approved qualification questions, capture project information, update your CRM, answer common questions, send follow-ups, and escalate conversations to your team when needed.

Human involvement

Exceptions, complex or sensitive conversations, and quality control remain with your team. Automation handles the repetitive steps in between.

FAQ

An AI assistant is a system that responds to inquiries, answers approved questions, and completes defined tasks like collecting information or updating records — without needing a person to handle every step manually.

An AI agent carries out a sequence of actions toward a goal — for example, qualifying a lead and then triggering the right follow-up — rather than just answering a single question.

n8n is a workflow automation tool that connects different systems (forms, CRMs, calendars, messaging platforms) so information moves between them automatically, based on rules you define.

Automation handles repetitive, well-defined steps. A person becomes involved for exceptions, complex questions, and anything requiring judgment — the workflow is designed to escalate rather than guess.
